input.free_text_description: The system operates in the messaging, microservices infrastructure domain. It serves User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include custom message listener, custom message sender.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to send and receive messages, so that I can communicate with other users in real time.
As a User, I want to interact with custom message listener functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
As a User, I want to interact with custom message sender functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
